March 20, 1986) is an Australian actress, television presenter, and model who portrayed Kate Kane/Batwoman in the Arrowverse (2018-2020), including starring as the titular character in the series Batwoman (2019-2020). In May 2020, Rose announced that she was leaving the role following the first season of Batwoman.[1] Pictured: Rose as Kate Kane from the pilot episode of Batwoman (2019) Contents 1 Work History 1.1 Acting Credits 2 External Links 3 References Work History Images of Ruby Rose Gallery of Ruby Rose's images Acting Credits The Flash 2014–2023 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Elseworlds, Part 1" December 9, 2018 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Crisis on Infinite Earths: Part Three" December 10, 2019 Kate Kane/Batwoman Arrow 2012–2020 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Elseworlds, Part 2" December 10, 2018 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Crisis on Infinite Earths: Part Four" January 14, 2020 Kate Kane/Batwoman Supergirl 2015–2021 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Elseworlds, Part 3" December 11, 2018 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Crisis on Infinite Earths: Part One" December 8, 2019 Kate Kane/Batwoman Batwoman 2019–2022 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Pilot" October 6, 2019 Kate Kane/Batwoman "The Rabbit Hole" October 13, 2019 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Down Down Down" October 20, 2019 Kate Kane/Batwoman "Who Are You?"
